interface.ui: Sign-in for the gate preview: GET /auth/preview (redirects to / with an owner session). Demo Project page /projects/demo, where each demo task's key ("T1", "T2", "T3") is shown in a link to its task page /tasks/{id} (id = decimal digits); an existing task page responds with HTTP status 200, document title "Task · Agents" and a card headed (h2) "Evidence package". Task page route /tasks/{id}. Not found page: HTTP status 404, visible text "This page could not be found.", no h2 "Evidence package". Malformed identifiers used by the checks: "invalid", "1.5", "-3", "0", "+5", "1e3", "0x10", "NaN", "Infinity", "12abc". Non-existent well-formed task numbers used by the checks: "999999" and "99999999999". No new routes, headings, labels, buttons or messages.

non_goals: Changing the content, design or wording of the Not found page itself.
Identifier handling of other routes, including the evidence-file page /tasks/{id}/artifacts/{aid}, /projects/{slug} and API routes.
Defining whether an all-digit identifier with leading zeros (for example /tasks/007) opens the task with that number or shows Not found.
Changing what a visitor without an owner session sees on /tasks/{id} (sign-in handling is unchanged).
Any change to the database schema, migrations, the control loop or the preview demo data.

scope.summary: Opening the task page route /tasks/{id} as the signed-in owner with an identifier that is not a positive whole number (for example /tasks/invalid, /tasks/1.5, /tasks/-3, /tasks/0) responds with HTTP status 404 and the ordinary Not found page, exactly like a well-formed task number for which no task exists (for example /tasks/999999 or a number too large to be any task's number). No such request ever responds with a server error (HTTP 5xx) or an error page. Task pages of existing tasks keep working.

title: A malformed task address shows Not found, not a server error
